sentences.en: A trip to Mars may become possible in my lifetime.
sentences.zh: 在我有生之年，去火星旅行可能成为可能。

sentences.en: I am determined to spend my lifetime pursuing my ideals.
sentences.zh: 我决心终生追求我的理想。

sentences.en: If you want happiness for a lifetime, help someone else.
sentences.zh: 如果你想获得一生的幸福，就帮助别人吧。
